note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927. The Larne Times nomination-day report lists all 16 district electoral divisions: contests in Ardclinis and Cairncastle; Islandmagee South left with one nominee after the retiring member withdrew; 11 other divisions with a single nominee; no nominations for Ballycorr and Templecorran, whose retiring members were deemed re-elected. The first meeting of the new council (LT 11 June 1927) names sixteen elected members. No nomination; retiring member deemed re-elected (printed 'Ballycorr'). Deemed re-elected (no nomination). Uncertain: Initials: the nomination report prints 'W. J. M'Creary'; the list of members at the first meeting (LT 11 Jun 1927 p2) prints 'S. F. M'Creary', and later rounds have S. M'Creary / Samuel M'Creery. Initials need review.
